tip
Death's Messenger cuts the Lichborne and Raise Dead cooldowns by 30 sec. Blinding Sleet is only in this build
tip
In Wowhead's build table, the raid, Mythic+ and Delve ★ are all on Deathbringer only
tip
Use Frostwyrm's Fury as soon as possible after Pillar of Frost. With Apocalypse Now all 4 Horsemen fight with you for 20 sec (Wowhead)
tip
Rider's Champion: each rune spent has a chance to bring a Horseman to help for 10 sec. Fury of the Horsemen extends it by 1 sec per 50 Runic Power (up to 5 sec)
tip

pos

tip
Pillar of Frost · 45 sec · +20% Strength for 12 sec. Use it on cooldown; do not hold it (Wowhead)
tip
Frostwyrm's Fury · 1 min 30 sec · 40-yard frontal AoE Frost damage and 3 sec stun. Do not use it without Pillar of Frost (Wowhead)

Chosen of Frostbrood: Frostwyrm's Fury grants 15% Haste (12 sec) and extends an active Pillar of Frost by 2 sec. After it flies off, call it again once at 50% effectiveness

Breath of Sindragosa · 1 min 30 sec · 60 Runic Power · frontal Frost damage for 8 sec. Each Killing Machine or Rime consumed extends it by 0.8 sec
tip
Empower Rune Weapon · 2 charges (30 sec) · 40 Runic Power and Killing Machine. Use it first when both charges are up (Wowhead)

Obliteration: during Pillar of Frost, Frost Strike and Howling Blast always grant Killing Machine. Press Obliterate more often in this window
int

tb

tb

tb

tb

tip
Battle res with Raise Ally (10 min, no Runic Power cost with Death Notes)

Devour week: shields are removed by healing received. Clear your own with Death Strike healing

deathbringer.title: Deathbringer points
items: For big pulls and boss burst, pop {Reaper's Mark} together with {Pillar of Frost}, then use {Exterminate}-empowered {Frostscythe}/{Obliterate} after the detonation
Use {Frostwyrm's Fury} right after {Pillar of Frost}, and save the second recall for when the most targets are up

rider-of-the-apocalypse.title: Rider of the Apocalypse points
items: Right after {Pillar of Frost}, call all 4 Horsemen with {Frostwyrm's Fury} and line them up with big pulls and boss burst windows
Take knockback and pull mechanics with {Death Charge} or {Death's Advance}

Rav'i: [광역 피해] Line up Anti-Magic Shell with Ravenous Stomp (145474 Nature to everyone). If Anti-Magic Shell is down for the Carrion Burst Nature DoTs that stack during Ssscavenging, take them with Icebound Fortitude (Topicx)

[광역 피해] Damage cooldowns go on every Ssscavenging shield. Use Pillar of Frost (45 sec) on every shield, and Frostwyrm's Fury and Breath of Sindragosa (1.5 min) on a shield whenever they are back (Topicx)
[위치] Run to distant Messy Eater puddles with Death's Advance and step on them
The Writhing Coil: [차단] Put Mind Freeze (15 sec) into the kick rotation for the three back-to-back Toxic Atrophy casts, and set the order in chat before the pull (Topicx)

[광역 피해] When Uncoil splits the boss into five Writhes, press Pillar of Frost and Breath of Sindragosa with Bloodlust and hit them together with Frostscythe. Hold any Writhe moving toward its Spiteful Hunt target with Frostwyrm's Fury's 3 sec stun (Topicx)
[광역 피해] Absorb Synchronized Venom's 35 sec Nature DoT with Anti-Magic Shell, and place Anti-Magic Zone if the group is stacked (Wowhead)
Zul'jan: [위치] Absorb the Nature damage taken every second while you body-block a Ritual of the Fang beam with Anti-Magic Shell. This beam channel is also when the group uses its defensives (Topicx·Wowhead)

[회피] Dodge the spinning Axegrinder axes quickly with Death's Advance. When you deliberately clip a slowed axe to clear Ritual Venom, keep Icebound Fortitude up because the hit is armor-ignoring Physical damage (Topicx·Icy Veins)

Lightblossom Trinity: [차단] Kezkitt's Light Bolt does not need a kick rotation. Kick it when Mind Freeze is available (Topicx)
[위치] When you stand in Fertile Loam to block Lightblossom Beam, absorb the Holy damage every 2 sec with Anti-Magic Shell (Wowhead)
[광역 피해] On Mythic Bedrock Surge (Nature damage every sec for 8 sec), place Anti-Magic Zone if the group is stacked closely (Wowhead)
Ikuzz the Light Hunter: [광역 피해] Absorb Thorncaller Roar's 6 sec Nature damage with Anti-Magic Shell, and use Icebound Fortitude when Lightcrazed Frenzy's Holy pulses overlap after 50%
[회피] If you are targeted by Bloodthirsty Gaze, gain distance with Death's Advance. Death's Advance also ignores the Verdant Stomp knockback
[해제] If Bloodthorn Roots holds you, break free with Death Charge (Rider of the Apocalypse build)
Lightwarden Ruia: [차단] Put Mind Freeze into the kick rotation for Warden's Wrath in Moonkin Form

[광역 피해] If marked by Pulverizing Strikes, stand still and take the 6 sec physical cones with Icebound Fortitude. If Grievous Thrash is still bleeding you, top yourself off with Death Strike to remove it
[광역 피해] After 40%, alternate Anti-Magic Shell and Icebound Fortitude through Spirits of the Vale. Lightfire Beams deal Radiant damage, so Anti-Magic Shell absorbs them
Ziekket: [차단] Before the revive, use Mind Freeze on the Lashers' Lightspore Shot
[광역 피해] When Lashers group up, chew them down together with Frostscythe and Howling Blast
[참고] When Oozing Xylem's Holy damage and orb DoTs stack up, absorb them with Anti-Magic Shell

The Hoardmonger: [위치] If you need to step on several Spoiled Supplies mushrooms, pop Anti-Magic Shell first to absorb the Toxic Spores Nature DoT (Wowhead)
[광역 피해] Ravenous Bellow is armor-ignoring physical damage and Anti-Magic Shell cannot block it; use Icebound Fortitude
Sentinel of Winter: [차단] Put Mind Freeze into the kick rotation for Fractured Shivercore's Winter's Shroud

[위치] As a melee, Frost takes the Fractured Shivercore next to the boss. Watch both adds' health and press Pillar of Frost and Breath of Sindragosa so yours dies at the same time as the ranged add (Topicx)

[광역 피해] Place Anti-Magic Zone for Frozen Tempest's group-wide Frost DoT. This is the best use in the dungeon. When the storm pushes you, ignore the forced movement with Death's Advance and stay inside the Snowdrift (Wowhead)
Nalorakk: [광역 피해] If Echoing Maul targets you, absorb the 193965 Nature damage the Echo deals within 8 yd with Anti-Magic Shell. If Anti-Magic Shell is not back, use Icebound Fortitude (Topicx)
[광역 피해] Absorb the Nature damage taken while body-blocking an Echo during Fury of the War God with Anti-Magic Shell
[광역 피해] If Overwhelming Onslaught's armor-ignoring triple Physical hit is heavy, use Icebound Fortitude

Kystia Manaheart: [광역 피해] Line up Pillar of Frost, Frostwyrm's Fury and Breath of Sindragosa with the 20 sec Destabilized window. It is better to put them here even if it costs you one cooldown use (Wowhead)
[차단] Use Mind Freeze on the Mirror Images' Felstorm; on the Deathbringer build, use Blinding Sleet on grouped images
[광역 피해] Chaos damage keeps hitting the party during Destabilized, so drop Anti-Magic Zone (Wowhead)
Zaen Bladesorrow: [광역 피해] Press Pillar of Frost, Breath of Sindragosa and Frostwyrm's Fury with the second Bloodlust as the fight starts together with the worker pack after the RP. Kill the Keen Taskmaster first, then clear the workers with Frostscythe. Hold low-health Warehouse Workers that run away with Chains of Ice or Death Grip (Topicx)
[광역 피해] Absorb stacking Fel-Infused Freight Fire DoTs with Anti-Magic Shell, and place Anti-Magic Zone when the group stacks (Wowhead)
[광역 피해] Killing Spree is armor-ignoring Physical damage, so survive it with Icebound Fortitude
Xathuux the Annihilator: [광역 피해] Line up Pillar of Frost and Frostwyrm's Fury with Demonic Rage, when the boss takes 30% more damage, and add Breath of Sindragosa on the second Demonic Rage where the third Bloodlust goes (Topicx)
[광역 피해] Absorb Infernal Crush's Fire damage with Anti-Magic Shell
Lithiel Cinderfury: [차단] Put Mind Freeze into the Chaos Bolt kick rotation
[위치] Absorb Malefic Wave with Anti-Magic Shell as you cross it so you do not lose damage uptime (Wowhead)

[광역 피해] Damage cooldowns go on Furious Vilefiend and Wild Imp spawns. Press Pillar of Frost and Breath of Sindragosa and kill the adds first with Frostscythe. The Deathbringer build delays Felfire Burst with Blinding Sleet (Topicx)

Taz'Rah: [광역 피해] Absorb Dark Bloom (174568 Shadow to everyone) with Anti-Magic Shell. It is the biggest group damage in this fight, so place Anti-Magic Zone here (Topicx)
[회피] Use Death's Advance to get out of Void Fissure before Umbral Rupture
Atroxus: [우선 처치] When the first Toxic Creeper spawns, line up Pillar of Frost, Breath of Sindragosa and Frostwyrm's Fury with Bloodlust and kill it fast (Topicx)
[광역 피해] When Toxic Aura and Poison Pool Nature damage drag on, absorb them with Anti-Magic Shell
Charonus: [위치] If Gravitic Orbs targets you, drag the orb to one of the two nearer Unstable Singularities because you are melee. With Death's Advance up you ignore the Condensed Mass slow and the Singularity's pull (Topicx·Wowhead)
[광역 피해] Absorb Cosmic Crash's 20 sec DoT and Condensed Mass's Shadow DoT with Anti-Magic Shell

The Golden Serpent: [우선 처치] Use Frostscythe on Animated Gold packs; on the Deathbringer build, slow them with Blinding Sleet so they do not reach the boss
[광역 피해] Absorb Serpentine Gust Nature AoE with Anti-Magic Shell and block the knockback with Death's Advance
Mchimba the Embalmer: [차단] Put Mind Freeze into the kick rotation for Half-Finished Mummy's and Finished Mummy's Wretched Discharge
[위치] When awakened mummies scatter, pull them next to the boss with Death Grip

[광역 피해] Bloodlust goes on this boss, so press Pillar of Frost, Breath of Sindragosa and Frostwyrm's Fury with Bloodlust at the start, and absorb the Awakening Slam Shadow group damage with Anti-Magic Shell (Topicx)
The Council of Tribes: [우선 처치] The longer Kula lives, the more Whirling Axes pile up, so stack Pillar of Frost, Breath of Sindragosa and Frostwyrm's Fury on Kula and kill her before the fourth set of axes. With Death's Advance up you ignore the Whirling Axes knockback (Topicx)
[차단] Kick Zanazal's Poison Nova with Mind Freeze, and if it is missed, absorb the 12 sec Nature DoT with Anti-Magic Shell
[우선 처치] When the Call of the Elements totems gather, cleave them down together with Frostscythe
Dazar, The First King: [우선 처치] Bloodlust goes at the start of Dazar, so stack Pillar of Frost, Breath of Sindragosa and Frostwyrm's Fury on Reban and kill him before 80%. In the Deathbringer build, put Reaper's Mark on Reban (Topicx)
[차단] Put Mind Freeze into the kick rotation for Reban's Deathly Roar, and if the kick looks likely to fail, block the 4 sec fear with Lichborne
[광역 피해] Absorb Gilded Destruction's instant Fire damage and 15 sec DoT with Anti-Magic Shell (Wowhead)

Melidrussa Chillworn: [차단] The tank kicks Frigid Shard right after the Hailburst ice lands, so follow up with Mind Freeze only when the tank misses it (Topicx)
[위치] Ignore Chillstorm's pull and the knockback of its explosion 7 sec later with Death's Advance

[우선 처치] Line up Pillar of Frost with breaking the 66% and 33% Ice Bulwark. The intermission with whelps and the shield is the biggest group damage, so place Anti-Magic Zone for Frost Overload (Topicx)
Kokia Blazehoof: [차단] Put Mind Freeze in the rotation for Blazebound Firestorm's Blaze Volley
[광역 피해] Drop Anti-Magic Zone for Inferno fire damage while the Firestorm is out. This is the best use of it in this dungeon (Wowhead)
Kyrakka & Erkhart Stormvein: [위치] Press Death's Advance so Winds of Change does not push you
[광역 피해] If Inferno Spit targets you, absorb the 6 sec DoT and the 8 yd explosion when the circle ends together with Anti-Magic Shell (Topicx)
[광역 피해] Stack Pillar of Frost, Frostwyrm's Fury and Breath of Sindragosa at the start of phase 2, and finish the boss with lower health first (Topicx)

Adderis & Aspix: [위치] Ignore the Gale Force knockback with Death's Advance (Wowhead)
[광역 피해] Absorb Thunder and Lightning Nature damage with Anti-Magic Shell
Merektha: [차단] Put Mind Freeze into the kick rotation for Toxic Viper's Poison Spit
[우선 처치] Use Frostscythe and Pillar of Frost on the Hatch adds, and cut down the Storm Serpent with double health first

[광역 피해] Absorb Serpentstorm's Nature group damage and 8 sec DoT with Anti-Magic Shell, and place Anti-Magic Zone here because the group needs a party defensive. With Death's Advance up the knockback does not push you into pools (Topicx)
Galvazzt: [위치] When blocking the Lightning Spire beam, absorb the Nature damage with Anti-Magic Shell to hold it longer (Wowhead)
[참고] If Galvanized has increased your physical damage taken by 250%, pop Icebound Fortitude
Avatar of Sethraliss: [차단] Use Mind Freeze on Twisted Hexxer's Flame Shock
[우선 처치] Line up Pillar of Frost and Frostwyrm's Fury with the Essence Defiler

[광역 피해] If Corrupted Guardian's Vile Charge (Shadow plus an 8 sec DoT) targets you, absorb it with Anti-Magic Shell, and press Icebound Fortitude when soaking Corrupted Lifeforce leaves you taking more Physical damage from Corruption (Method)

For 10 sec, while upon your Death Charger your movement speed is increased by 100%, you cannot be slowed below 100% of normal speed, and you are immune to forced movement effects and knockbacks.

444040.d: Army of the Dead and Frostwyrm's Fury call upon all 4 Horsemen to aid you for 20 sec. (1s cooldown)

444069.d: Every 50 Runic Power you spend extends the duration of the Horsemen's aid in combat by 1 sec, up to 5 sec.

456230.d: Consuming Killing Machine fires a Glacial Advance through your target at 60% effectiveness. (300ms cooldown)

1230153.d:
Obliterate and Frostscythe consume all Killing Machines to deal 25% increased critical strike damage and grant 1.5% Haste for 8 sec for each stack consumed.

Multiple applications may overlap.

1230301.d:
Obliterate deals 10% increased damage and has a chance to tether the souls of its target and a nearby enemy to yours.

Frost Strike severs the tethers, dealing (411.84% of Attack Power) Shadowfrost damage to both foes. (700ms cooldown)

1249658.m: Talent · 60 Runic Power · Instant · 1.5 min cooldown
1249658.d:
Call upon Sindragosa's aid in battle for 8 sec, continuously dealing [(111.83% of Attack Power) * [(Attack Power * 0.98)][((Attack Power + Offhand Attack Power) * 2 / 3)] -- 2H, DW / Attack Power] Frost damage every 1 sec to enemies in a cone in front of you. Consuming Killing Machine or Rime increases the duration by 0.8 sec. Deals reduced damage to secondary targets.

Grants a charge of Empower Rune Weapon at the start and 2 Runes at the end. (100ms cooldown)

1265632.d: Frostwyrm's Fury deals 100% increased damage to the first enemy it hits and grants you 15% Haste for 12 sec.

1265637.d:
All Frost damage increased by 10%.

Frostwyrm's Fury deals 100% increased damage. After the Frostwyrm flies away, you may cast Frostwyrm's Fury again to recall it at 50% effectiveness.

1265932.d:
Frost Strike damage is increased by 35% and Glacial Advance damage is increased by 5%.

Reaper's Mark grants 3 charges of Bonegrinder if it is known.

(500ms cooldown)

1265959.d: Pillar of Frost summons forth Trollbane for 6 sec.

1266818.d: The cooldown of Death Pact is reduced by 30 sec, and you receive 50% increased healing while its healing absorb is active.

1266819.d: Raise Ally costs 30 less Runic Power.

3714.d:
냉기를 발산해 10분 동안 50미터 내에 있는 파티원 또는 공격대원의 발 아래 얼음을 만들어 수면을 걸을 수 있게 합니다.

탈것을 탄 상태에서 사용할 수 있습니다. 공격을 받거나 피해를 입으면 효과가 사라집니다.

45524.m: 룬 1 / 룬 마력 -10 · 30 야드 사정거리 · 즉시
45524.d: 대상을 얼음의 사슬로 속박하여, 8초 동안 이동 속도를 70%만큼 감소시킵니다.

46585.m: 특성 · 30 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 2 분 재사용 대기시간
46585.d: [문양: 외눈깨비: 외눈깨비 / 구울]을 소환하여 자신을 도와 싸우게 합니다. 동시에 하나의 [문양: 외눈깨비: 외눈깨비 / 구울]만 부릴 수 있습니다. 1분 동안 지속됩니다.

47528.m: 특성 · 15 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 15 초 재사용 대기시간
47528.d: 대상의 정신을 냉기로 얼려 주문 시전을 방해하고 5초 동안 같은 계열의 주문을 시전하지 못하도록 만듭니다.

47568.m: 특성 · 30 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 30 초 재사용 대기시간 · 2회 사용 가능
47568.d: 적의 의지를 흡수하여 룬 무기를 강화해 (전투력의 260%)의 암흑냉기 피해를 입히고 주위의 적에게는 감소된 피해를 입힙니다. 40의 룬 마력을 생성하며 도살기를 부여합니다.

48265.m: 즉시 · 45 초 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
48265.d:
10초 동안 이동 속도가 35%만큼 증가하며, 평상시 이동 속도의 최소 100%를 유지합니다. 강제 이동 효과 및 밀쳐내기에 면역이 됩니다.

지속효과: 평상시 이동 속도의 최소 70%를 유지합니다.

48707.d: 5초 동안 자신을 대마법 보호막으로 감싸 최대 [총 생명력 * 30 / 100 * (1 + 유연성) * 1 * 1]의 마법 피해를 흡수하고, 해로운 마법 효과에 걸리지 않게 합니다. 피해를 흡수하면 룬 마력이 생성됩니다.

48743.d: 죽음의 서약을 맺어 최대 생명력의 50%를 회복하지만, 15초 동안 최대 생명력의 30%에 해당하는 치유량을 흡수합니다.

48792.d: 피가 얼어붙어 8초 동안 기절 효과에 면역이 되고, 받는 모든 피해가 30%만큼 감소합니다.

49020.d: 잔혹하게 [공격하여 [(전투력의 116.304%)]의 물리 피해와 [(전투력의 116.304%)]의 냉기 피해를 입힙니다.][쌍수 무기로 공격하여 총 [((전투력의 78.5643%) + (전투력의 78.5643%))]의 물리 피해와 [((전투력의 78.5643%) + (전투력의 78.5643%))]의 냉기 피해를 입힙니다.]

49039.d: 부정의 에너지를 끌어내 10초 동안 언데드가 되어, 생기흡수가 6%만큼 증가하고 현혹과 공포, 수면에 면역이 됩니다.

49143.m: 특성 · 룬 마력 35 · 근접 사정거리 · 즉시
49143.d: 한기의 힘을 [무기에 불어넣고 적을 즉시 가격하여 총 [(전투력의 198.089%)]의 냉기 피해를 입힙니다.][쌍수 무기에 불어넣고 적을 즉시 가격하여 총 [(전투력의 139.308%) + (전투력의 139.308%)]의 냉기 피해를 입힙니다.]

49184.m: 특성 · 룬 1 / 룬 마력 -10 · 30 야드 사정거리 · 즉시
49184.d:
살을 에는 혹한의 바람으로 대상에게 [(전투력의 50.6819%) * [(전투력 * 0.98)][((전투력 + 보조 무기 전투력) * 2 / 3)] -- 2H, DW / 전투력]의 [노스렌드 바람: 냉기 피해를 입히고 서리 열병에 감염시킵니다 / 냉기 피해를 입히고 10미터 내의 다른 모든 적에게 감소된 피해를 입힙니다. 영향받는 적은 모두 서리 열병에 감염됩니다.]

서리 열병
질병을 일으켜 24초에 걸쳐 [(전투력의 342.4%) * [(전투력 * 0.98)][((전투력 + 보조 무기 전투력) * 2 / 3)] -- 2H, DW / 전투력]의 냉기 피해를 입히고, 피해를 입힐 때마다 죽음의 기사는 일정 확률로 4의 룬 마력을 얻습니다.

49576.m: 30 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 25 초 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
49576.d:
모든 물질을 감싸고 결합시키는 힘을 이용해 대상을 끌어당깁니다
[
플레이어 간 전투에서는 재사용 대기시간이 10초만큼 증가합니다.]

49998.m: 특성 · 룬 마력 45 · 근접 사정거리 · 즉시
49998.d: 어둠의 힘을 양손의 무기로 집중시켜 일격에 총 [(전투력의 176.1%) + (전투력의 29.835%)]의 물리 피해를 입힙니다. 또한, 지난 5초 동안 받은 모든 피해의 (20 / 탐식: 21 / 죽음의 일격 연마: 32)%에 해당하는 만큼 자신의 생명력을 치유합니다. 최소 치유량은 최대 생명력의 7.0%입니다.

50977.m: 룬 1 / 룬 마력 -10 · 4 초 주문 시전 시간 · 1 분 재사용 대기시간
50977.d:
죽음의 기사가 칠흑의 요새로 돌아가는 데 필요한 죽음의 관문을 엽니다.

칠흑의 요새에서 죽음의 관문을 사용하면 처음 떠났던 지점 근처로 되돌아갑니다.

51052.m: 특성 · 30 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 4 분 재사용 대기시간
51052.d: 6초 동안 거대한 대마법 지대를 생성하여 내부의 파티원이나 공격대원이 받는 마법 피해를 15%만큼 감소시킵니다.

51128.d: 자동 공격이 치명타로 적중하면 일정 확률로 다음 절멸이 냉기 피해를 입히고 치명타 및 극대화로 적중하거나, 혹은 다음 서리낫이 치명타 및 극대화로 적중해 일반 공격력의 4배에 해당하는 피해를 입힙니다.

59057.d: 냉기의 일격 및 빙하 진군 사용 시 45%의 확률로 다음 울부짖는 한파가 룬을 소모하지 않고 275%의 추가 피해를 입힙니다.

61999.m: 룬 마력 30 · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 10 분 재사용 대기시간
61999.d: 죽은 대상의 영혼과 육체를 암흑의 기운으로 재결합시켜, 60%의 생명력과 최소 20%의 마나를 지닌 상태로 부활하게 합니다.

194912.d: 냉혹한 겨울의 지속시간 동안 소비한 룬 하나당 냉혹한 겨울의 공격력이 10%만큼, 지속시간이 0.5초만큼 증가합니다.

194913.m: 특성 / 전문화 · 룬 마력 35 · 100 야드 사정거리 · 즉시
194913.d: 정면으로 진군하는 빙하 쐐기를 소환해 쐐기가 솟아나는 지점 주위의 적에게 각각 [(전투력의 82.4557%) * [(전투력 * 0.98)][((전투력 + 보조 무기 전투력) * 2 / 3)] -- 2H, DW / 전투력]의 냉기 피해를 입히고 칼날얼음을 부여합니다.

196770.m: 룬 1 / 룬 마력 -10 · 즉시 · 20 초 재사용 대기시간
196770.d: 8미터 내에 있는 모든 적의 생명의 온기를 흡수하여 8초에 걸쳐 [9 * (전투력의 12.6462%) * [(전투력 * 0.98)][((전투력 + 보조 무기 전투력) * 2 / 3)] -- 2H, DW / 전투력]의 냉기 피해를 입히고 대상의 이동 속도를 20%만큼 감소시킵니다.

205727.d: 대마법 보호막의 재사용 대기시간이 20초만큼 감소하고, 지속시간과 흡수량이 40%만큼 증가합니다.

206967.d: 자신의 생명력이 30% 이하일 때 받는 피해는 20%만큼 감소합니다.

207167.d:
전방 부채꼴 범위에 있는 대상의 눈을 멀게 하여 5초 동안 방향 감각을 상실하고 방황하게 만듭니다. 대상이 피해를 입으면 효과가 취소될 수 있습니다.

눈부신 진눈깨비가 종료되면 6초 동안 적의 이동 속도가 50%만큼 감소합니다.

207230.d:
휩쓸기 공격으로 전방에 있는 모든 적에게 (전투력의 48%)의 냉기 피해를 입힙니다. 5명을 초과하는 대상에게는 감소된 피해를 입힙니다.

도살기를 소모해 치명타 및 극대화 공격이 일반 공격력의 4배에 해당하는 피해를 입히도록 합니다.

279302.d: 서리고룡을 소환해 시전자 전방 40미터 내의 모든 적에게 숨결을 내뿜어 (전투력의 296.6%)의 냉기 피해를 입히고, 3초 동안 기절시킨 뒤, 10초 동안 이동 속도를 50%만큼 감소시킵니다.

281238.d:
얼음 기둥의 지속시간 동안 냉기의 일격 [빙하 진군: 빙하 진군] 및 울부짖는 한파가 항상 도살기를 부여하고 20%의 확률로 룬을 생성합니다.

추가로 얼음 기둥의 지속시간 동안 룬 무기 강화 사용 시 다음 절멸 또는 서리낫이 룬을 소모하지 않습니다.

356367.d: 죽음의 진군, 죽음과 부패, 죽음의 손아귀가 추가로 1회 충전됩니다.

377098.d: 도살기를 소모하면 10초 동안 치명타 및 극대화율이 1%만큼 증가합니다. 최대 5번까지 중첩됩니다. 5번 중첩되면 다음 도살기를 소모할 때 중첩을 소모하여 10초 동안 냉기 공격력이 10%만큼 증가합니다. (700밀리초 재사용 대기시간)

377190.d: 얼음 기둥이 만료되면, 6초 동안 힘이 8%만큼 증가합니다. 얼음 기둥이 지속되는 동안 절멸과 서리낫이 치명타로 적중할 때마다 이 효과의 지속시간이 2초씩, 최대 20초만큼 증가합니다.

377226.d:
얼음 기둥 사용 시 지속시간이 4초만큼 증가한 냉혹한 겨울이 발동합니다.

냉혹한 겨울로 피해를 입힌 적 하나당 15초 동안 특화가 (4 * $mastery)%만큼, 최대 (4 * $mastery * 5)%만큼 증가합니다.

378848.d: 정신 얼리기로 적의 주문 시전을 성공적으로 방해하면 10의 룬 마력을 얻고 재사용 대기시간이 3초만큼 감소합니다.

437122.d: 리치의 혼과 시체 되살리기의 재사용 대기시간이 30초만큼 감소합니다.

439843.m: 특성 · 룬 2 · 근접 사정거리 · 즉시 · 45 초 재사용 대기시간
439843.d:
매섭게 적의 영혼을 베어 (전투력의 234%)의 암흑냉기 피해를 입히고 사신의 징표를 겁니다.

암흑 또는 냉기 피해를 입힐 때마다 사신의 징표 중첩을 부여합니다. 12초 후에 또는 40번 중첩 시 징표가 폭발해 중첩 하나당 (전투력의 30.364%)의 피해를 입힙니다.

대상이 사망할 경우 사신의 징표는 징표에 걸리지 않은 주위의 적에게 전이됩니다.

439851.d:
사신의 징표가 암흑냉기 마력의 파동을 바깥쪽으로 방출한 후 다시 끌어당겨 이동 경로상의 모든 적에게 (전투력의 96.7079%)의 암흑냉기 피해를 입힙니다.

영혼의 파도가 치명타 및 극대화 효과를 발휘하면 15초 동안 적이 받는 암흑냉기 피해가 5%만큼 증가합니다. 최대 2번까지 중첩됩니다. 또한 돌아오는 파도는 항상 치명타 및 극대화 효과를 발휘합니다.

440282.d: 룬을 소모할 때마다 받는 마법 피해가 1.5%만큼 감소합니다. 또한 룬을 생성할 때마다 받는 물리 피해가 1.5%만큼 감소합니다. 5초 동안 지속되며, 최대 5번까지 중첩됩니다.

441378.d:
사신의 징표가 폭발한 후에 다음 2회의 절멸 또는 서리낫이 룬 1개를 소모하며 낫 2개를 소환해 적을 가격합니다.

첫 번째 낫은 대상을 가격해 (전투력의 440.205%)의 암흑냉기 피해를 입히고 100%의 확률로 도살기를 부여하며, 두 번째 낫은 대상 주위의 모든 적을 가격해 (전투력의 178.008%)의 암흑냉기 피해를 입히고[추가로 서리 열병을 부여합니다.] 8명을 초과하는 대상에게는 감소된 피해를 입힙니다.

(1초 재사용 대기시간)

444005.d:
룬 소모 시 일정 확률로 10초 동안 4인 기사단의 일원을 소환합니다.

모그레인
자신의 위치에 죽음과 부패를 시전합니다. 이 죽음과 부패는 모그레인을 뒤따라 이동하며, 피해를 입힐 때마다 시전자의 질병의 지속시간을 1.0초만큼 연장시킵니다.

화이트메인
대상에게 불사를 시전하여 24초 동안 3초마다 중첩 하나당 (전투력의 6.86532%)의 암흑냉기 피해를 입힙니다. 불사는 피해를 입힐 때마다 중첩이 쌓입니다. 이 효과는 갱신되지 않습니다.

트롤베인
대상에게 얼음 결계를 시전하여 이동 속도를 40%만큼 감소시키고 8초 동안 죽음의 기사에게 받는 피해를 5%만큼 증가시킵니다.

나즈그림
나즈그림이 활성화된 동안 종말의 정복자가 부여되어 힘이 5%만큼 증가합니다.

444010.d:
죽음의 군마를 불러내 이동 방해 효과에서 벗어납니다.

죽음의 군마에 탑승하면 10초 동안 이동 속도가 100%만큼 증가하며, 평상시 이동 속도의 최소 100%를 유지하고 강제 이동 효과 및 밀쳐내기 효과에 면역이 됩니다.

444040.d: 사자의 군대와 서리고룡의 격노 사용 시 20초 동안 4인 기사단 전원을 부릅니다. (1초 재사용 대기시간)

444069.d: 50의 룬 마력을 소모할 때마다 전투를 돕는 기사단의 지원 지속시간이 1초만큼, 최대 5초만큼 증가합니다.

456230.d: 도살기를 소모하면 대상을 향해 60%의 효율로 빙하 진군을 내보냅니다. (300밀리초 재사용 대기시간)

1230153.d:
절멸 및 서리낫 사용 시 모든 도살기를 소모하여 중첩 하나당 8초 동안 치명타 및 극대화 피해가 25%만큼, 가속이 1.5%만큼 증가합니다.

여러 번 사용 시 효과가 중첩됩니다.

1230301.m: 특성 · 매 분마다 약 5번 효과 발동됨
1230301.d:
절멸의 공격력이 10%만큼 증가하며, 사용 시 일정 확률로 대상과 주위 적 한 명의 영혼을 자신과 사슬로 연결합니다.

서리낫을 사용하면 이 사슬이 끊어지며 두 적에게 (전투력의 411.84%)의 암흑냉기 피해를 입힙니다. (700밀리초 재사용 대기시간)

1249658.m: 특성 · 룬 마력 60 · 즉시 · 1.5 분 재사용 대기시간
1249658.d:
전투 중 8초 동안 신드라고사의 도움을 받아, 전방 부채꼴 범위 내의 적에게 1초마다 [(전투력의 111.83%) * [(전투력 * 0.98)][((전투력 + 보조 무기 전투력) * 2 / 3)] -- 2H, DW / 전투력]의 냉기 피해를 입힙니다. 도살기 또는 단단한 얼음을 소모하면 지속시간이 0.8초만큼 증가합니다. 부가 대상에게는 감소된 피해를 입힙니다.

효과가 발동할 때 룬 무기 강화가 1회 충전되고 끝날 때 룬 2개가 생성됩니다. (100밀리초 재사용 대기시간)

1265632.d: 서리고룡의 격노가 처음 적중하는 적에게 100%의 추가 피해를 입히고 12초 동안 가속이 15%만큼 증가합니다.

1265637.d:
모든 냉기 공격력이 10%만큼 증가합니다.

서리고룡의 격노가 100%의 추가 피해를 입힙니다. 서리고룡이 날아간 후에는 다시 서리고룡의 격노를 시전하여 50%의 효율로 다시 부를 수 있습니다.

1265932.d:
냉기의 일격의 공격력이 35%만큼, 빙하 진군의 공격력이 5%만큼 증가합니다.

사신의 징표를 배웠을 경우, 사신의 징표가 뼈 분쇄 3중첩을 부여합니다.

1265959.d: 얼음 기둥 시전 시 6초 동안 트롤베인을 소환합니다.

1266818.d: 죽음의 서약의 재사용 대기시간이 30초만큼 감소하며, 죽음의 서약의 피해 흡수 효과가 활성화된 동안 받는 치유 효과가 50%만큼 증가합니다.

1266819.d: 아군 되살리기의 룬 마력 소모량이 30만큼 감소합니다.

1: [차단] Put Mind Freeze (15 sec) into the kick rotation for Radiant Spellsower's Light Bolt Volley (4 sec cast, 174568 Holy).

[위치] When a Spellsower runs to a dormant Lasher pack with Call The Grove, pull it back with Death Grip (2 charges with Death's Echo) to stop Frantic Blooming, then apply Chains of Ice (70% slow for 8 sec) so it cannot run again.

[광역 피해] Once everything is stacked and Bloodlust is up, use Pillar of Frost together with Frostwyrm's Fury (1.5 min). Absorb Sporeblight Belcher's Spouting Floret (87284 Holy every 2 sec for 6 sec) with Anti-Magic Shell (40 sec with Anti-Magic Barrier, 7 sec duration).
2: [차단] When both Radiant Spellsowers cast Light Bolt Volley, kick one with Mind Freeze and Death Grip the other to stop its cast and bring it to the tank. The Deathbringer build can stop both at once with Blinding Sleet (1 min, 5 sec frontal-cone disorient).
[광역 피해] Use Anti-Magic Shell for Spouting Floret. If the Anti-Magic Shell from pull 1 (40 sec) is not back yet, take it with Icebound Fortitude (2 min, 30% damage reduction for 8 sec).
3: [차단] Split the two Radiant Spellsowers' Light Bolt Volley between Mind Freeze and Death Grip, and put Chains of Ice on any Spellsower that runs with Call The Grove.
[회피] When Virid Grovekeeper casts Uproot (3 sec cast), press Death's Advance (45 sec, 2 charges). It makes you immune to knockbacks for 10 sec so you keep your melee position.
[우선 처치] When a Lightgorged Lasher activates its Lightbloom Pollination shield (absorbs 600108, immune to crowd control), focus Obliterate on that Lasher and break the shield first.
5: [차단] Kick Lightfeather Petalwing's Disorienting Screech (4 sec cast) with Mind Freeze. If it goes off, the whole group is disoriented for 3 sec.
[제어] When Thorny Saptor jumps in with Thornclaw Leap, aim Frostwyrm's Fury (40 yd frontal, 3 sec stun) at the Saptor to stop the follow-up cone attacks. Pair it with Pillar of Frost.

[광역 피해] Use Anti-Magic Shell on the first-pulled Sporeblight Belcher's Spouting Floret, and press Death's Advance for the Uproot of the Virid Grovekeeper that arrives 5-6 sec later to ignore the knockback.
7: [차단] Kick Lightfeather Petalwing's Disorienting Screech with Mind Freeze, and kick Leafy Grovecrawler's Seed Shot when you have it spare. In the Rider of the Apocalypse build, Coldthirst cuts Mind Freeze's cooldown by 3 sec on every successful kick.
[제어] If Frostwyrm's Fury is ready, stun both Thorny Saptors for 3 sec to stop their Thornclaw Leap.

[참고] While Spineshield Beetle's Spiny Shield is up on the 5 beetles, every Frostscythe or Howling Blast hit returns 4849 Nature damage. Press Anti-Magic Shell while breaking the shields to absorb the reflected damage.
8: [차단] The two Leafy Grovecrawlers cast Seed Shot (2.5 sec cast) from range, so Death Grip (2 charges) them into the pack and kick the next Seed Shot with Mind Freeze.
[광역 피해] Timing Anti-Magic Shell for Sporeblight Belcher's Spouting Floret also absorbs the reflected Nature damage from Spineshield Beetle's Spiny Shield.
[제어] Stop the two Thorny Saptors' Thornclaw Leap with Frostwyrm's Fury (3 sec stun).
10: [광역 피해] Frost cannot dispel Potatoad Matriarch's Toxic Spew (2 sec cast, 67888 Nature plus a 9 sec poison DoT). When you see the cast, press Anti-Magic Shell to absorb the hit and the Nature damage of the DoT.
[우선 처치] When a Lightgorged Lasher activates its Lightbloom Pollination shield, nearby mobs gain 50% attack speed, so focus Obliterate on that Lasher and break the shield (600108).
[참고] Potatoad Matriarch has a lot of health and lives long, so in the Deathbringer build put Reaper's Mark (45 sec) on the Matriarch together with Pillar of Frost.
11: [차단] When all three Lightfeather Petalwings cast Disorienting Screech, the Deathbringer build stops them at once with Blinding Sleet (5 sec frontal-cone disorient); kick the rest with Mind Freeze.
[광역 피해] Use Anti-Magic Shell for Spouting Floret. If the Anti-Magic Shell used on pull 10's Toxic Spew (40 sec) is not back, take it with Icebound Fortitude.
12: [우선 처치] When the six Lightgorged Lashers activate Lightbloom Pollination shields, stack Pillar of Frost, Frostwyrm's Fury and Breath of Sindragosa (1.5 min) on this pull to break the shields together.
[차단] Split the two Radiant Spellsowers' Light Bolt Volley between Mind Freeze and Death Grip; the Deathbringer build can stop both at once with Blinding Sleet.
[광역 피해] Use Anti-Magic Shell for Sporeblight Belcher's Spouting Floret.

1: [차단] Take one of the two Primal Serpents' Piercing Hiss (4 sec cast, 135775 armor-ignoring Physical) with Mind Freeze (15 sec).

[제어] If the seven Ravenous Descendants stack attack speed with Ravenous Claws and the tank starts taking heavy damage, aim Frostwyrm's Fury (1.5 min, 40 yd frontal, 3 sec stun) at the pack. Three seconds without melee swings drops the 2 sec stacks. Pair it with Pillar of Frost.

[광역 피해] Absorb Twinfang Harrower's Paralyzing Shots (48491 Nature every sec for 20 sec) with Anti-Magic Shell (40 sec with Anti-Magic Barrier, 7 sec duration). The stacking slow cannot take you below 70% movement speed thanks to Death's Advance's passive.
2: [우선 처치] Focus Obliterate on the Ritual Chieftain. In the Deathbringer build, put Reaper's Mark (45 sec) on the Chieftain.

[광역 피해] Blood Sacrifice (87284 Physical to the whole group plus a 162029 heal absorb) is Physical, so Anti-Magic Shell does not stop it. Take it with Icebound Fortitude (2 min, 30% damage reduction for 8 sec), and absorb Unstable Totem (29095 Nature every 2 sec while the Chieftain lives) with Anti-Magic Shell.
3: [차단] When the three Primal Serpents walk down behind the pillar, kick one with Mind Freeze. If kicks run short, the Deathbringer build stops the remaining Piercing Hiss with Blinding Sleet (1 min, 5 sec frontal-cone disorient). In the Rider of the Apocalypse build, Coldthirst cuts Mind Freeze's cooldown by 3 sec on every successful kick.
[광역 피해] If the Icebound Fortitude (2 min) used on pull 2 is not back for Blood Sacrifice, top yourself off with Death Pact (1.5 min with Death Defiance, heals 50% of max health).
4: [우선 처치] Line up Pillar of Frost (45 sec) on the Ritual Chieftain to kill it before several Blood Sacrifices land, and take one Primal Serpent's Piercing Hiss with Mind Freeze.
5: [광역 피해] This is the biggest pull at 103 trash. Press Pillar of Frost, Breath of Sindragosa (1.5 min) and Frostwyrm's Fury together and melt the Ritual Chieftain first.
[광역 피해] Absorb the two Twinfang Harrowers' Paralyzing Shots DoTs and Unstable Totem's Nature damage with Anti-Magic Shell, and take Blood Sacrifice's Physical damage with Icebound Fortitude.
[회피] Dodge Toxic Breath (3 sec cast, 67888 Nature every 0.5 sec) by swinging to the Harrower's side quickly with Death's Advance (45 sec, 2 charges with Death's Echo).
7: [차단] Kick High Evolutionist's Mass Envenom (3.5 sec cast) with Mind Freeze, and break Evolve (6 sec channel) with Frostwyrm's Fury's 3 sec stun to deny the shield and crowd-control immunity. The same stun also stops the three Bloodletters' melee swings.
[광역 피해] Rattling Writhe's Rattle (58189 armor-ignoring Physical every sec for 5 sec) is Physical, so take it with Icebound Fortitude and absorb any remaining Envenom Nature DoT with Anti-Magic Shell.
8: [제어] Stun all four Bloodletters for 3 sec with Frostwyrm's Fury to delay the blood pools. If the Frostwyrm's Fury (1.5 min) used on pull 7 is not back, the Deathbringer build holds them with Blinding Sleet. Damage breaks it, but a 50% slow lingers for 6 sec after it ends.
[광역 피해] If Icebound Fortitude is not back for Rattle, top yourself off with Death Strike to survive it.
9: [위치] Pull the High Evolutionist standing far to the left into the pack with Death Grip (25 sec, 2 charges with Death's Echo), and kick its Mass Envenom with Mind Freeze.
[우선 처치] Press Pillar of Frost and focus Obliterate on the two High Evolutionists to kill them before the second Mass Envenom.
11: [차단] Kick your assigned High Evolutionist's Mass Envenom with Mind Freeze, and when several channel Evolve together, stun them at once with Frostwyrm's Fury. The Deathbringer build can also stop the channels with Blinding Sleet.
[광역 피해] If several unkicked Envenom Nature DoTs stack on you, absorb them with Anti-Magic Shell.
12: [우선 처치] Ascendant Serpent must die before the third Infest, so line up Pillar of Frost and Breath of Sindragosa on this mini-boss, and put Reaper's Mark on it in the Deathbringer build.
[광역 피해] When Infest hits you (34914 Nature every sec for 5 sec, then 69827 Nature within 8 yd), absorb it with Anti-Magic Shell.
13: [우선 처치] Focus Obliterate on Ula'tek's Chosen and do not pour Frostscythe or Breath of Sindragosa into the six Living Venoms at once. Mass Envenom must be kicked every time, so save Mind Freeze for the Chosen.
[광역 피해] Absorb Toxic Surge (29095 Nature every sec for 9 sec) with Anti-Magic Shell, and during it stun the two Blades of the Altar with Frostwyrm's Fury to stop their Laced Edge teleports.
14: [제어] If the Frostwyrm's Fury (1.5 min) used on pull 13 is not back, the Deathbringer build holds the Blades of the Altar with Blinding Sleet during Toxic Surge.
[광역 피해] If Anti-Magic Shell (40 sec) is not back for Toxic Surge, take it with Icebound Fortitude.
15: [차단] Take one of the two Primal Serpents' Piercing Hiss with Mind Freeze.
[광역 피해] Absorb Twinfang Harrower's Paralyzing Shots DoT with Anti-Magic Shell, and step out of the Toxic Breath frontal with Death's Advance.
16: [우선 처치] Stack Pillar of Frost, Breath of Sindragosa and Frostwyrm's Fury to kill Ula'tek's Chosen before the second Toxic Surge. Kick the Chosen's Mass Envenom with Mind Freeze.

[광역 피해] The two Ritual Chieftains' Blood Sacrifices come back to back, so take the first with Icebound Fortitude and the second with Death Pact. Absorb Toxic Surge's Nature damage with Anti-Magic Shell.
[광역 피해] When the group stacks for Toxic Surge, place Anti-Magic Zone (4 min, 15% magic damage reduction for the party for 6 sec). This pull has the heaviest healing load.

1: [우선 처치] This is a Bloodlust pull. Press Pillar of Frost, Breath of Sindragosa (1.5 min) and Frostwyrm's Fury and focus Obliterate on the Bribed Captain. Deep Corruption reduces nearby mobs' area damage taken by 25%, so Obliterate beats Frostscythe while the Captain lives. In the Deathbringer build, put Reaper's Mark (45 sec) on the Captain.

[광역 피해] Frost cannot dispel Street Sneak's Heartstop Poison (193965 Nature over 8 sec, stacking 5% max health reduction). When stacks build up, absorb the Nature damage with Anti-Magic Shell (40 sec with Anti-Magic Barrier, 7 sec duration).
2: [차단] Take one of the two Seductive Sayaads' Seduction (3 sec cast, 6 sec disorient) with Mind Freeze (15 sec). The Deathbringer build can stop the other with Blinding Sleet (1 min, 5 sec frontal-cone disorient).
[회피] Felwyrms explode with Fel Detonation (193965 Fire) within 4 yd when they die. As a melee, step outside 4 yd when a Felwyrm is low, and absorb it with Anti-Magic Shell if several die together.
3: [차단] Kick the two Felonious Mages' Fel Missiles channel with Mind Freeze. In the Rider of the Apocalypse build, Coldthirst cuts Mind Freeze's cooldown by 3 sec on every successful kick.
[회피] If all six Felwyrms die at once, the Fel Detonations overlap, so press Anti-Magic Shell and finish them with Frostscythe.
4: [제어] Stacks build fast when four Street Sneaks hit with Heartstop Poison-coated weapons. Stop all four at once with Frostwyrm's Fury (1.5 min, 40 yd frontal, 3 sec stun) to slow the stacking, and kick Felonious Mage's Fel Missiles with Mind Freeze.
5: [우선 처치] Press Pillar of Frost and focus Obliterate on the Massive Felwyrm. While it lives, Burning Fel (38793 Fire within 50 yd) lands every 3 sec, so absorb it with Anti-Magic Shell.
[회피] When the Massive Felwyrm casts Massive Fel Detonation as it dies (5 sec cast, 290947 Fire within 10 yd), get outside 10 yd with Death's Advance (45 sec, 2 charges with Death's Echo).
8: [차단] Kick Wrathguard Flayer's Fel Rage (3.5 sec cast) with Mind Freeze, and stop Fel Invoker's Health Funnel channel with Blinding Sleet in the Deathbringer build.
[회피] Step outside 12 yd of Shivan Punisher's Whirlwind (4 sec cast, 290947 Physical within 12 yd) with Death's Advance and come back.
[우선 처치] When the Punisher activates Demonic Frenzy below 50%, line up Pillar of Frost and Breath of Sindragosa to kill it fast, and absorb the 29095 Fire every second with Anti-Magic Shell.
9: [광역 피해] If Corrupted Warlock's Drain Life targets you, press Anti-Magic Shell, or take it with Icebound Fortitude (2 min, 30% damage reduction for 8 sec) if Anti-Magic Shell is not back. Anti-Magic Shell also absorbs your share when you stack near the Curse of Doom target (581895 Shadow split within 4 yd after 10 sec).

[차단] Kick the two Wrathguard Flayers' Fel Rage with Mind Freeze, and when the Warlock shields itself with Dark Pact at 50%, focus Obliterate to break it. Hit the eight Demon Flies together with Frostscythe.
10: [차단] Kick Fel Invoker's first Health Funnel with Mind Freeze, and stop the second Invoker with Blinding Sleet in the Deathbringer build.
[우선 처치] When the Shivan Punisher drops below 50%, line up Frostwyrm's Fury and Pillar of Frost to shorten Demonic Frenzy, and dodge Whirlwind with Death's Advance.
11: [광역 피해] Take Felmaster Lucsei's Blade Dance (43642 Fire every 0.4 sec for 1.2 sec) by alternating Anti-Magic Shell and Icebound Fortitude. When it is your turn for a group defensive, place Anti-Magic Zone (4 min, 15% magic damage reduction for the party for 6 sec).
[우선 처치] Stack Pillar of Frost, Breath of Sindragosa and Frostwyrm's Fury on Lucsei to finish it before a third Blade Dance. Stand so Eye Beam's frontal faces away from the group.
13: [광역 피해] Absorb Defiled Golem's Defiled Slam (145474 Fire to everyone) with Anti-Magic Shell, and place Anti-Magic Zone for the group if it is back.

[차단] Kick Wrathguard Flayer's Fel Rage with Mind Freeze and hit the six Unleashed Imps together with Frostscythe. The Deathbringer build can delay the Imps' Felfire Burst all at once with Blinding Sleet.
14: [차단] Take one of the two Wrathguard Flayers' Fel Rage with Mind Freeze, and stop Fel Invoker's Health Funnel with Blinding Sleet (Deathbringer build). In the Rider build, use the Coldthirst-shortened Mind Freeze again on the second Fel Rage.
[광역 피해] Six Unleashed Imps and the Felhunters are stacked here, so press Pillar of Frost and clear the Imps first with Frostscythe.
15: [광역 피해] Kill the Corrupted Warlock pulled back first. If Drain Life targets you, use Anti-Magic Shell and save Icebound Fortitude for the separate Shivan Punisher fight.
[우선 처치] When the Punisher drops below 50%, line up Pillar of Frost, Breath of Sindragosa and Frostwyrm's Fury to shorten Demonic Frenzy.
16: [우선 처치] Stack Pillar of Frost, Breath of Sindragosa and Frostwyrm's Fury on the Defiled Golem so it dies within two area casts. Kick Fel Invoker's Health Funnel with Mind Freeze.
[광역 피해] Cover one of the two Defiled Slams for the group with Anti-Magic Zone, and absorb the Fire damage on yourself with Anti-Magic Shell.

1: [광역 피해] This is the first Bloodlust pull. Press Pillar of Frost, Breath of Sindragosa (1.5 min) and Frostwyrm's Fury (1.5 min) together.

[우선 처치] Turn Obliterate on the Starvation Effigy totem to break it before the second Insatiable Hunger stack, and absorb Spirit of Hunger's Feast of Misery (38793 Shadow every sec for 5 sec) with Anti-Magic Shell (40 sec with Anti-Magic Barrier, 7 sec duration).
2: [차단] Kick Earthwhisper Tender's Healing Breeze (3.5 sec cast) and Earth Bolt (2.5 sec cast, 116379 Nature) with Mind Freeze (15 sec). In the Rider of the Apocalypse build, Coldthirst cuts Mind Freeze's cooldown by 3 sec on every successful kick.
[광역 피해] Absorb Feast of Misery's Shadow damage with Anti-Magic Shell. If pull 1's Anti-Magic Shell is not back, take it with Icebound Fortitude (2 min, 30% damage reduction for 8 sec).
3: [차단] Kick Earthwhisper Tender's Healing Breeze with Mind Freeze, and absorb Feast of Misery with Anti-Magic Shell.
4: [광역 피해] When the three Keen-Eyed Strikers' Razor Dive bleeds (33944 Physical every sec for 10 sec, stacking) pile up, use Icebound Fortitude and top yourself off with Death Strike. Absorb Feast of Misery with Anti-Magic Shell.
7: [광역 피해] This is the cooldown pull after the boss. Press Pillar of Frost, Breath of Sindragosa and Frostwyrm's Fury again.
[차단] Kick one of the two Earthwhisper Tenders' Healing Breeze with Mind Freeze, and pull the other, standing back, into the corner pack with Death Grip (25 sec, 2 charges with Death's Echo).
8: [우선 처치] Focus Obliterate on Terra Rumbler's Rumbling Ward shield. In the Deathbringer build, put Reaper's Mark (45 sec) on the Rumbler. Absorb the 24246 Nature pulse every 2 sec while the shield is up with Anti-Magic Shell.
9: [광역 피해] This is the second Bloodlust pull. Press Pillar of Frost, Breath of Sindragosa and Frostwyrm's Fury together.
[차단] Kick Frigid Mauler's Frigid Roar (3.5 sec cast) with Mind Freeze. When both cast together, the Deathbringer build stops the other one with Blinding Sleet (1 min, 5 sec frontal-cone disorient).
[위치] If Glacial Revenant's Cryo Surge (48491 damage within 4 yd) targets you, move away from the group quickly with Death's Advance (45 sec, 2 charges).
10: [차단] Split the two Frigid Maulers' Frigid Roar between Mind Freeze and Blinding Sleet (Deathbringer build). In the Rider build, use the Coldthirst-shortened Mind Freeze again on the next Roar.
[광역 피해] If the two Glacial Revenants' Cryo Surges overlap on you, absorb them with Anti-Magic Shell.
11: [우선 처치] Press Pillar of Frost and focus Obliterate on the Avatar of Determination, then break the Terra Rumbler's shield.

[회피] When you see Pulverize (4 sec cast, 4 sec stun and 387930 Physical within 12 yd), step outside 12 yd with Death's Advance and come back. If Glacial Tomb (38793 Frost every 2 sec) encases you, absorb it with Anti-Magic Shell.
13: [차단] Kick Stormbound Mystic's Arc Lightning (4 sec cast, 193965 Nature) with Mind Freeze.

[우선 처치] Turn Obliterate on Ruthless Totemcaller's Magma Totem and break it first. When Grizzled Warbringer's Primal Echo (armor-ignoring Physical, stacking) builds up, take it with Icebound Fortitude.
14: [우선 처치] Break the two Ruthless Totemcallers' Magma Totems right away with Obliterate, and absorb the Fire damage before then (36368 every 0.3 sec) with Anti-Magic Shell.
[광역 피해] If the third Bloodlust goes here, press Pillar of Frost, Breath of Sindragosa and Frostwyrm's Fury with it. In higher keys, save these cooldowns for Loa Speaker Nanea.
15: [광역 피해] This is a large pull at 85 trash. Stack Pillar of Frost, Breath of Sindragosa and Frostwyrm's Fury to melt the four Grizzled Warbringers.

[광역 피해] The Warbringers alternate Primal Echo, so take the first with Icebound Fortitude and the next with Death Pact (1.5 min with Death Defiance, heals 50% of max health). Absorb Magma Totem's Fire damage with Anti-Magic Shell.
[차단] Take one of the two Stormbound Mystics' Arc Lightning with Mind Freeze, and stop the other with Blinding Sleet in the Deathbringer build.
16: [차단] Kick Loa Speaker Nanea's Lightning Bolt with Mind Freeze.

[우선 처치] When the three Volatile Totems appear, turn Frostscythe and Obliterate on the totems unless Nanea is around 10% health. If Bloodlust goes here in higher keys, line up Pillar of Frost and Breath of Sindragosa before the second totem wave.
[위치] If Earthquake targets you, drop the zone outside the group with Death's Advance and return to melee right away.

1: [차단] The tank takes the first kick on Voidtouched Magi's Shadowbolt Volley, so take the second kick with Mind Freeze (15 sec). In the Rider of the Apocalypse build, Coldthirst cuts Mind Freeze's cooldown by 3 sec on every successful kick.

[광역 피해] This is a Bloodlust pull. Press Pillar of Frost, Breath of Sindragosa (1.5 min) and Frostwyrm's Fury and focus Obliterate on the Magi. If Null Eruption (145474 Shadow within 10 yd plus a 5 sec DoT) targets you, leave the group with Death's Advance and absorb it with Anti-Magic Shell (40 sec with Anti-Magic Barrier, 7 sec duration).
2: [우선 처치] When Raj'kess the Spellstorm summons the three Orbs of Disruption, run to them with Death's Advance (45 sec, 2 charges with Death's Echo) and break them right away with Obliterate. If even one finishes its cast, the group's Haste drops sharply.

[광역 피해] Use Icebound Fortitude (2 min, 30% damage reduction for 8 sec) for the long Thundering Storm group damage, and absorb Forked Lightning (77586 Nature, bounces to 2 players) with Anti-Magic Shell.
3: [광역 피해] Press Anti-Magic Shell for Chitigoth's Insidious Aura (87284 Nature every 2 sec for 10 sec), and place Anti-Magic Zone (4 min, 15% magic damage reduction for the party for 6 sec) if the group is stacked.

[우선 처치] When Brutok hits a wall and is stunned for 5 sec by Concussion, it takes 20% more Physical damage. Press Pillar of Frost and focus Obliterate then. In the Deathbringer build, put Reaper's Mark (45 sec) on Brutok.
[위치] Run to a distant Angry Krolusk with Death's Advance and kill it fast. Violent Sand's 40% slow cannot take you below 70% movement speed thanks to Death's Advance's passive.
5: [차단] Kilivore Screamer's Mad Shriek (3.5 sec cast, 6 sec fear within 60 yd) is the most important kick in this area, so save Mind Freeze for it. If the kick looks likely to fail, press Lichborne (2 min, 1.5 min with Death's Messenger in the Deathbringer build, fear immunity for 10 sec) in advance.
[광역 피해] If Watchful Harrower's Void Beam (43642 Shadow every 0.5 sec for 4 sec) targets you, move out of the group and absorb it with Anti-Magic Shell.
6: [우선 처치] Stack Pillar of Frost, Breath of Sindragosa and Frostwyrm's Fury to break Brutal Overseer's Brutal Slams shield fast. Until it breaks, the Physical damage grows 10% every 1.5 sec.
[광역 피해] Take the stacking Brutal Slams Physical damage with Icebound Fortitude, and line up Anti-Magic Shell with Watchful Harrower's Sky Strike soak (872842 Nature shared).
8: [우선 처치] This is a damage cooldown pull. Press Pillar of Frost, Breath of Sindragosa and Frostwyrm's Fury, and turn Obliterate on the Devour (9 sec cast) target of the Devouring Brutalizer right away to kill it before the cast ends.

[광역 피해] Dreadbellow (4.5 sec cast, knockback plus 29095 Shadow every sec for 12 sec) cannot be dispelled, so absorb it with Anti-Magic Shell. With Death's Advance up you ignore the knockback and keep your melee position.

[차단] Kick Kilivore Screamer's Mad Shriek with Mind Freeze first, and stop the two Voidminders' Mending Void channel with Blinding Sleet (1 min, 5 sec frontal-cone disorient) in the Deathbringer build.
9: [광역 피해] Hit the ten Scavenging Siphoids together with Frostscythe, and use Breath of Sindragosa on this pack if it is back.
[차단] Kick Kilivore Screamer's Mad Shriek with Mind Freeze first, and cover Enthralled Shaman's Lava Bolt with your remaining kicks. Absorb Dreadbellow with Anti-Magic Shell.
10: [광역 피해] This is the last big pull at 117 trash. Stack Pillar of Frost, Breath of Sindragosa and Frostwyrm's Fury to melt the Devouring Brutalizer first. Absorb the Dreadbellow Shadow DoT with Anti-Magic Shell.
[광역 피해] If Anti-Magic Shell is not back for Watchful Harrower's Sky Strike soak or Void Beam, use Icebound Fortitude. Kick Voidminder's Mending Void when Mind Freeze is spare.

1: [광역 피해] This is the first pull of the dungeon, so use Bloodlust (Topicx). Press Pillar of Frost, Breath of Sindragosa (1.5 min) and Frostwyrm's Fury with Bloodlust, and hit both Animated Guardians and the Shadow-Borne Champion together with Frostscythe.

[광역 피해] Absorb Shadow-Borne Champion's Shadow Whirlwind (4 sec cast, 164870 Shadow within 100 yd) with Anti-Magic Shell (40 sec with Anti-Magic Barrier, 7 sec duration). If Anti-Magic Shell is not back for the next cast, use Icebound Fortitude (2 min, 30% damage reduction for 8 sec).
2: [차단] Kick Risen Hexer's Hex Volley (3.5 sec cast, 116379 Shadow plus a 12 sec curse DoT) with Mind Freeze (15 sec). In the Rider of the Apocalypse build, Coldthirst cuts the cooldown by 3 sec on every successful kick, so you can also cover Shadowfrost Bolt.
[광역 피해] The corner pack is a cooldown pull (Topicx). Press Pillar of Frost (45 sec), and take Shadow Whirlwind with Anti-Magic Shell if it is back from pull 1, otherwise with Icebound Fortitude.
4: [차단] Put Queen Wasi's Bind Soul and Soul Bolt and Seneschal M'bara's Unholy Mending into the Mind Freeze rotation. If Bind Soul (10 sec charm) looks likely to go off, press Lichborne (2 min, 1.5 min with Death's Messenger in the Deathbringer build, charm and fear immunity for 10 sec) in advance.

[우선 처치] Press Pillar of Frost only after the tank has aggro on the pack that wakes up (Topicx). Save Breath of Sindragosa and Frostwyrm's Fury for the hardest pack, King A'akul with the Bloodsworn Assassins.

[광역 피해] If Blood Drain (164870 Physical) comes while you carry the Sudden Rupture bleed (18 sec Physical), take it with Icebound Fortitude and refill your health with Death Strike. Absorb King Rahu'ai's Forked Lightning (77586 Nature, bounces to 2 players) with Anti-Magic Shell.
5: [광역 피해] Absorb Purification Construct's Purifying Flame (174568 Fire to the whole group) with Anti-Magic Shell. If the healer cannot keep up while you move the pools, place Anti-Magic Zone (4 min, 15% magic damage reduction for the party for 6 sec) where the group stands.

[참고] If you use Bloodlust here on a high key, line up Pillar of Frost and Breath of Sindragosa with it, and hit the pulled Embalming Fluids together with Frostscythe and Remorseless Winter (20 sec, 8 yd).
6: [차단] Take one of the two Half-Finished Mummies' Wretched Discharge (4 sec cast, 12 sec disease DoT on the whole group) with Mind Freeze. Frost cannot remove diseases, so absorb a missed DoT (116379 Nature) with Anti-Magic Shell.
7: [차단] On the other side, also take one of the two Half-Finished Mummies' Wretched Discharge with Mind Freeze.

[광역 피해] Hit the eight Embalming Fluids together with Frostscythe and Remorseless Winter. The 20% slow from Putrid Seekers pools cannot take you below 70% movement speed thanks to Death's Advance's passive.
9: [우선 처치] Press Pillar of Frost on the two Spectral Shamans and focus Obliterate on them. If a Healing Tide Totem is already down, break it right away with Obliterate.

[차단] Kick the two Phantom Hex Priests' Hex (3.5 sec cast, 5 sec polymorph) with Mind Freeze, and if both cast at once, stop them together with Frostwyrm's Fury (1.5 min, 3 sec stun in a 40 yd frontal area) or Blinding Sleet (1 min, 5 sec frontal-cone disorient) in the Deathbringer build.
[광역 피해] When Royal Berserker's Bloodthirsty Axe bleeds (12 sec Physical) stack up, press Icebound Fortitude and refill your health with Death Strike.
10: [우선 처치] On a four-Bloodlust route this pull is the third Bloodlust (Topicx). Melt the Ghostly Brute first with Pillar of Frost, Breath of Sindragosa and Frostwyrm's Fury, and in the Deathbringer build put Reaper's Mark (45 sec) on the Brute.

[회피] When Ghostly Brute starts Seismic Upheaval (5 sec cast, 387930 Physical nearby), press Death's Advance (35% movement speed for 10 sec) and run out of range. Kick the remaining Phantom Hex Priest's Hex with Mind Freeze.
12: [광역 피해] If Shadow of Zul's Dark Revelation targets you, move more than 20 yd away from the group with Death's Advance and absorb the explosion 5 sec later (473120 Shadow) with Anti-Magic Shell.
[우선 처치] Press Pillar of Frost after the tank engages first and focus Obliterate. Shadow of Zul is a single target worth 30 count, so use Obliterate instead of Frostscythe.

1: [차단] Flashfrost Chillweaver's Ice Shield (15 sec channel, a CC-preventing shield on an ally) must be kicked, so take one of the two with Mind Freeze (15 sec). In the Rider of the Apocalypse build, Coldthirst cuts the cooldown by 3 sec on every successful kick.

[제어] If the tank's Tectonic Strike stacks get high, stop the four Deepstone Earthshapers with Frostwyrm's Fury (1.5 min, 3 sec stun in a 40 yd frontal area) so the stacks fall off, and press Pillar of Frost and focus Obliterate on the CC-immune Primal Juggernaut.
[광역 피해] Absorb Primal Juggernaut's Excavating Blast (106681 Nature within 60 yd plus an 8 sec DoT) with Anti-Magic Shell (40 sec with Anti-Magic Barrier, 7 sec duration).
2: [차단] Kick Flashfrost Chillweaver's Ice Shield with Mind Freeze and focus Obliterate on the Primal Juggernaut. Absorb the Excavating Blast Nature damage with Anti-Magic Shell as on pull 1.
3: [차단] Kick Flashfrost Chillweaver's Ice Shield with Mind Freeze so the CC-preventing shield does not stack on Defier Draghar.

[광역 피해] Each strike of Defier Draghar's Steel Barrage sets off a 60 yd Fire nova (24246), so absorb it with Anti-Magic Shell. Press Pillar of Frost and focus Obliterate on Draghar (30 count, CC immune).
5: [차단] Kicks go to the two Primalist Cinderweavers' Cinderbolt first (Topicx). Put Mind Freeze into the Cinderbolt rotation.

[제어] Ashseer Flamelasher's Flaming Barrage cannot be kicked, so break it with the 3 sec stun of Frostwyrm's Fury, and stop the other one with Blinding Sleet (1 min, 5 sec frontal-cone disorient) in the Deathbringer build.

[광역 피해] Absorb Blazebound Destroyer's Inferno (96982 Fire within 60 yd plus a 5 sec DoT) with Anti-Magic Shell. If Living Bomb targets you, move more than 6 yd away from the group with Death's Advance (45 sec, 2 charges with Death's Echo).
6: [우선 처치] Below 50% Flamegullet (40 count, CC immune) keeps raising group damage with Molten Blood. On +17 and above Bloodlust goes at 50% (Topicx), so line up Pillar of Frost and Breath of Sindragosa (1.5 min) then and kill it fast.

[광역 피해] When Molten Blood Fire damage stacks up, place Anti-Magic Zone (4 min, 15% magic damage reduction for the party for 6 sec) where the group stands, and absorb the Destroyer's Inferno with Anti-Magic Shell.
[제어] Kick the Cinderweaver's Cinderbolt with Mind Freeze and break the Flamelasher's Flaming Barrage with the Frostwyrm's Fury stun.
7: [제어] If Frostwyrm's Fury from pull 6 is not back, split the two Ashseer Flamelashers' Flaming Barrage between Blinding Sleet in the Deathbringer build and another player's stun. Mind Freeze goes on Cinderbolt.
[광역 피해] Absorb Inferno and Living Bomb Fire damage with Anti-Magic Shell, and when the dying Destroyer starts Burnout (20 yd explosion), leave right away with Death's Advance.
8: [제어] Break both Ashseer Flamelashers' Flaming Barrage together with the Frostwyrm's Fury stun, and kick Primalist Cinderweaver's Cinderbolt with Mind Freeze. Do not use Death Grip on this pack because it can drag in the patrolling Thunderhead.
10: [광역 피해] Hit the six Storm Warriors together with Frostscythe and Remorseless Winter (20 sec, 8 yd), and use Breath of Sindragosa on this pack.

[광역 피해] If Tempest Channeler's Lightning Torrent targets you, absorb the 7 sec channel (65463 Nature every sec) with Anti-Magic Shell. Break Ashseer Flamelasher's Flaming Barrage with the Frostwyrm's Fury stun.
11: [차단] Kick Primalist Cinderweaver's Cinderbolt with Mind Freeze, and if Lightning Torrent targets you while Anti-Magic Shell is not back, use Icebound Fortitude (2 min, 30% damage reduction for 8 sec).
12: [우선 처치] When High Channeler Ryvati (30 count, CC immune) puts up Tempest Stormshield (a shield worth 20% of max health), press Pillar of Frost and Breath of Sindragosa and break it fast with Obliterate. If your group uses Bloodlust here on a high key, line them up with it (Topicx).

[광역 피해] Absorb the 29095 Nature that pulses every sec while the shield is up with Anti-Magic Shell. If the shield looks likely to expire unbroken, press Icebound Fortitude (stun immunity) so the 60 yd 4 sec stun does not hit you.

1: [위치] On the left route, pull the first Storm Adept with Death Grip (25 sec, 2 charges with Death's Echo) and bring it down to the pack (Topicx).

[우선 처치] Line up Pillar of Frost, Breath of Sindragosa (1.5 min) and Frostwyrm's Fury on the CC-immune Sandfury Stonefist and kill it first. The 3 sec stun of Frostwyrm's Fury also breaks Sandswept Hunter's Arrow Barrage.

[차단] If Storm Adept's Lightning Bolt lands together with Ground Pound (4 sec cast, 156627 Physical within 60 yd plus knockback), people die, so time Mind Freeze (15 sec) for that moment. With Death's Advance up you ignore the Ground Pound knockback and keep meleeing.
2: [차단] Put both Storm Adepts' Lightning Bolt into the Mind Freeze rotation and do not miss a kick during the Ground Pound cast. In the Rider of the Apocalypse build, Coldthirst cuts the cooldown by 3 sec on every successful kick.
[제어] Stop Sandswept Hunter's Arrow Barrage (9 sec channel) with Blinding Sleet (1 min, 5 sec frontal-cone disorient) in the Deathbringer build, and use Pillar of Frost (45 sec) on the Stonefist.
4: [우선 처치] Press Pillar of Frost on the Sand-Sworn Rider and focus Obliterate to kill it before more Swarming Krolusks come. In the Deathbringer build, put Reaper's Mark (45 sec) on the Rider.
[차단] Kick Storm Adept's Lightning Bolt with Mind Freeze and break Sandswept Hunter's Arrow Barrage with the Frostwyrm's Fury stun.
5: [차단] If the two Storm Adepts' Lightning Bolt lands on someone hit by a Krolusk charge or Cytotoxin, that player dies, so do not miss your Mind Freeze turns (Topicx).

[광역 피해] At 91 trash this is the largest pull of the area. Press Pillar of Frost, Breath of Sindragosa and Frostwyrm's Fury and hit the Sand-Sworn Rider and Krolusk Matriarch together with Frostscythe.
[광역 피해] If the Serrated Charge bleed and the Cytotoxin poison land on you together, press Icebound Fortitude (2 min, 30% damage reduction for 8 sec) and refill your health with Death Strike.
6: [차단] One player is enough for Faithless Subjugator's Addle Mind (5 sec cast), so agree in advance to take it with Mind Freeze, and spend remaining kicks on Brood Tender's Venom Bolt (Topicx).
7: [차단] Kick Brood Tender's Venom Bolt with Mind Freeze so its Nature damage does not land on top of the Cytotoxin poison (Topicx). If the player assigned to Addle Mind misses it, follow up with Mind Freeze.
[광역 피해] When Cytotoxin (72737 Nature plus a 10 sec DoT) from the three Poisonous Vipers stacks up, absorb it with Anti-Magic Shell (40 sec with Anti-Magic Barrier, 7 sec duration).
9: [광역 피해] Absorb Agitated Nimbus's Release Charge (145474 Nature to the whole group) with Anti-Magic Shell, and place Anti-Magic Zone (4 min, 15% magic damage reduction for the party for 6 sec) when both Nimbuses go off back to back.
[차단] Use Mind Freeze while the group is taking Release Charge damage so Imbued Stormcaller's Lightning Bolt kicks do not leak (Topicx).
10: [차단] Stop both Imbued Stormcallers before gathering the other mobs (Topicx). Kick one with Mind Freeze, and pull the other in with Death Grip to break its cast.

[광역 피해] Absorb Release Charge with Anti-Magic Shell, and use Icebound Fortitude if the four Static Anomalies' Spark Step stacks on top. Hit the Static Anomalies together with Frostscythe and Remorseless Winter (20 sec, 8 yd).
12: [회피] Do not rush the second Loose Sparks section before this pull (290947 Nature and a 6 sec stun); dodge it carefully. If it is hard to dodge, press Icebound Fortitude and pass through without being stunned.
[차단] Kick Temple Disruptor's Essence Disruption channel with Mind Freeze, and hold the Disruptor on the other side with Blinding Sleet in the Deathbringer build or the Frostwyrm's Fury stun.
[광역 피해] Absorb Orb Watcher's Caustic Stomp (116379 Nature within 60 yd plus a 10 sec DoT) with Anti-Magic Shell.
13: [차단] Kick Temple Disruptor's Essence Disruption with Mind Freeze and absorb Caustic Stomp with Anti-Magic Shell. If Frostwyrm's Fury from pull 12 is not back, leave the Disruptor on the other side to another player's crowd control.
14: [차단] Twisted Hexxer (CC immune) Flame Shock must be kicked, so save Mind Freeze for it.

[제어] The four Faithless Tormentors chase only the healer, so hold them with Frostwyrm's Fury (3 sec stun, then 50% slow for 10 sec) and Remorseless Winter, and slow any that slip out with Chains of Ice (70% slow for 8 sec). Hit the gathered pack together with Frostscythe.
[회피] If Latent Hex targets you, move more than 10 yd away from the group with Death's Advance and do not step in the Hex Muck it leaves when it ends.
